references.text: The tribe of Simeon received its inheritance within the territory of Judah, and several of the same cities are mentioned here, including Beer-Sheba, Silhim, and Rimmon.
Rimmon is mentioned as a campsite during Israel's journey in the wilderness.
A parallel list of cities in the territories of Judah and Simeon, where many of the same city names are repeated.
En-Rimmon is mentioned as a city where the Jews settled after returning from exile, referring to the same area.
Rimmon south of Jerusalem is mentioned in Zechariah's prophecy about the transformation of the land in the last days.
